scope: ca/ce derived forms and duration expressions
findings: saniyelerce becomes saniyelerde at center and negative offset, including sentence saniyelerce bekledim. Positive offset retains it.
milisaniyelerce becomes milisaniyelerde at all three offsets.
dakikalarca/saatlerce and dakikalarca bekledim preserved at all offsets.
Explicit base noun roots generate none of the47 ca/ce forms; production accepts29 through available lexical paths. Existing roots include dakikalarca/saatlerce; saniye exists but saniyelerce absent.
classification: Productive ca/ce coverage gap masked by lexical entries; two duration-word corruptions, not47 independent bugs.
limits: ca/ce has multiple grammatical functions; this corpus does not establish a single universal derivation rule.
No full production root trace for each accepted form, lexical rescue explicitly checked only for named roots.

Core harness only; no UI or production changes.
